author: TEDx Talks
description:
AI won’t replace us, but it will erase communities that don’t actively teach it who they are. Neighborhoods like Roxbury can become the blueprint for stopping that erasure. Algorithmic equity begins at the neighborhood level, and the communities that act now will write the rules for those that follow. Neighborhoods can intentionally 'train' AI by creating a coordinated digital blueprint: structured stories, cultural markers, and institutional signals that teach algorithms who we are.  

Angela Pitter builds digital visibility for the organizations and neighborhoods that algorithms overlook. As Founder & CEO of LiveWire Collaborative, an AI and digital strategy firm, she serves large nonprofits and mid-sized organizations navigating AI's impact on their communities and credibility. Angela's path runs from Bronx Science to a Computer Engineering degree at Boston University to 25 years of global technology leadership, before she pivoted to mission-driven work across Greater Boston. title: Is AI erasing your neighborhood? | Angela Pitter | TEDxRoxbury

author: TEDx Talks
description: When something goes wrong, we rush to fix it. But too often, nothing changes, not because we lack solutions, but because we never stopped to ask what was actually broken. In this talk, organizational psychologist Jessica Diaz introduces a deceptively simple framework that reveals what’s underneath the problems we keep trying to solve: when things aren’t working as intended, it almost always traces back to one of three root causes, a gap in knowledge, skill, or mindset. Drawing on two decades of work with leaders and organizations, and one memorable refrigerator incident, Diaz shows how a misaligned solution doesn’t just fail to fix the problem, it quietly creates new ones. The people with the greatest power to solve our most pressing problems aren’t the ones who always have the answer, they’re the ones willing to turn the framework on themselves first. Because in doing so, they shape the conditions that determine whether anything actually changes. Jessica Diaz, Ph.D., is an organizati
title: The Problem Isn’t the Problem  | Jessica Diaz | TEDxClaremont Graduate University

description:
Justin Vazquez is a Creative Director at Eidos-Montréal with over 25 years of experience designing stories and systems across music, film, television, and video games. Most recently, he led the creative direction for Grounded 2, the critically acclaimed sequel developed in collaboration with Obsidian Entertainment. He is also the author of The Build: A System for Self-Actualization, where he applies decades of experience designing systems that shape player behavior to the challenge of human growth.

In his TEDx talk, The Build: Self-Actualization is a System, Not Magic, Justin challenges the cultural myth that success inevitably requires sacrifice. Drawing on lessons from game design, psychology, music, elite performance, and his own journey through cancer, divorce, developing Grounded 2, and rebuilding his life, he presents a practical framework built on three trainable pillars: Autonomy, Mastery, and Harmony. By replacing shame with diagnosis and treating personal growth as a system
title: The Build: Self-Actualization is a System, Not Magic | Justin Vazquez | TEDxJeffersonU

author: TEDx Talks
description: Dympna Weil, MD, is a physician and writer who spent two decades as a board-certified OBGYN before a vestibular disorder ended her clinical practice in 2020. A Master Certified Coach and founder of Prescribing Possibility, her writing and expertise have appeared in The New York Times' Modern Love, Newsweek, and Parade. In her TEDx talk, she explores a question she now asks in nearly every hard conversation: is this a share, or a fix? Drawing on medicine and motherhood, she offers a simple diagnostic that changes what happens when someone is struggling and what real help looks like. author: TEDx Talks
description: This speech explores the concept of "re-entry injury": the emotional wound and identity struggle that occurs when returning to a former environment after personal growth. Through his personal journey as a second-generation Nigerian American, Jamal Benson illustrates this phenomenon, from a traumatic childhood visit to Nigeria that left him with a physical scar, to a painful adult return where he felt like an outsider in his parents' homeland. Jamal introduces a four-pillar healing framework called ROOT—Recognition, Openness, Ownership, and Touchstones—designed to help navigate these emotional returns. Ultimately, Jamal discovers that healing from re-entry injury isn't about erasing the past but about reclaiming authorship of one's own narrative and understanding that while the wound may not fully heal, the journey itself is a direction worth pursuing. title: Re-entry injury: A speech on returning | Jamal Benson | TEDxJeffersonU

author: TEDx Talks
description:
As high school students, we are often asked, “What do you want to be?” At an age when the future can feel both exciting and overwhelming, we are expected to choose a single noun to define who we are: a doctor, a designer, a teacher, an entrepreneur. But what if we are asking the wrong question? Drawing from his own journey across education, content creation, writing, poetry, acting, and music, Nguyễn Cảnh Luân explores how seemingly unrelated interests can come together to form a meaningful direction. Rather than defining ourselves by the titles we hold, he invites us to look deeper at the verbs that keep appearing throughout our experiences - the things we love to explain, create, express, connect, or solve. Through this perspective, our different interests become less like scattered choices and more like notes in the same song. Forget your nouns. Find your verbs.
 Nguyễn Cảnh Luân is an educator, content creator, author, and creative artist whose work spans language, education, know
title: Forget your nouns. Find your verbs | Cảnh Luân Nguyễn | TEDxLuong The Vinh Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: He opens the talk mid-performance — a live aria from The Magic Flute, the same one he teaches in classrooms across Portugal. António Wagner Diniz spent decades as an opera singer and ran Lisbon's National Conservatory; now he spends his time bringing music into schools in the country's poorest neighborhoods. The moment worth waiting for: a story about a five-year-old who watched two singers perform an argument in song and immediately recognized it as her own parents fighting at home. It's a small moment that says everything about why he believes opera isn't just entertainment — it's a way for children to finally see feelings they don't yet have words for. Watch it, and see why he thinks the future needs more of this, not less. António Wagner Diniz holds degrees in Economics and Music and has built a distinguished career as an opera singer, musical performer, and cultural animator since 1975. His most notable social and musical projects include Orquestra Geração – El Sistema Portugal a
title: Future Opera | António Wagner Diniz, Mariana Lourenço Chaves & Pedro Vieira de Almeida | TEDxMarvila

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Từ một cậu học sinh cấp ba chưa biết tương lai sẽ đi về đâu, Lâm Đạo Đạo bắt đầu hành trình sáng tạo bằng sự tò mò và những sở thích tưởng chừng chẳng liên quan: nhảy, nhiếp ảnh, hội họa, nội thất, âm nhạc hay DJ. Những trải nghiệm ấy từng bước đưa anh đến với vai trò Creative Director & Director, đồng hành cùng nhiều nghệ sĩ và thương hiệu lớn, cũng như góp phần tạo nên những dự án vươn ra quốc tế. Qua câu chuyện của mình, Lâm Đạo Đạo sẽ cùng chúng ta nhìn lại cách những điều tưởng như “vô bổ” lại có thể trở thành chất liệu để mở rộng góc nhìn, nuôi dưỡng tư duy sáng tạo và tạo nên dấu ấn riêng. Bởi đôi khi, ta không cần biết trước tất cả những điểm đến; chỉ cần đủ tò mò để bước đi, những mảnh ghép tưởng chừng rời rạc rồi sẽ tìm được cách kết nối với nhau. Không có trải nghiệm nào là vô nghĩa, nếu ta biết cách biến chúng thành một phần của chính mình.
 Lâm Đạo Đạo is a Vietnamese Director known for his distinctive visual storytelling across the music and film industries. Since beginn
title: Nothing is wasted | Đạo Đạo Lâm | TEDxLuong The Vinh Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
For many students, English begins as something they are expected to learn rather than something they genuinely want to explore. Surrounded by grades, exams, comparison, and expectations, a language meant to connect us with the world can gradually become a source of pressure and anxiety. Drawing from her own experience preparing for the National Excellent Student Competition in English, Trần Nguyễn Minh Như reflects on how she moved from feeling intimidated and inadequate to finding her own reason to keep learning. Through her story, she invites us to look beyond scores and achievements, and to reconsider what truly keeps us moving forward when external motivation is no longer enough. Perhaps overcoming the fear of English does not begin with becoming the best, but with finding something within the language that makes us want to take the next step. Let curiosity guide you, and let English grow with you - not as a burden to carry, but as a bridge to the world and to yourself.
 Trần Nguy
title: English anxiety is real? | Minh Như Trần Nguyễn | TEDxLuong The Vinh Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Growing up, we are often taught to measure ourselves through grades, achievements, and the people around us. For Lê Thị Quỳnh Như, that habit once made her feel as though no achievement was ever quite enough. Even when she was doing well, she was still looking sideways, wondering if she was good enough compared to everyone else. Her journey through competitions, English, and public speaking gradually taught her to see things differently: that finding yourself is not about becoming the most outstanding person in the crowd, but about understanding what makes you uniquely you. In her talk, Quỳnh Như reflects on the journey from comparison to self-discovery, and how embracing our differences can help us grow with greater confidence and purpose. Because sometimes, finding your place is not about fitting into the crowd, but finding the courage to discover who you are beyond it.
 Le Thi Quynh Nhu is a student from English Specialized Class 1 at Luong The Vinh High School for the Gifted. She
title: Finding myself beyond the crown  | Quỳnh Như Lê Thị | TEDxLuong The Vinh Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: The speech explores how culture, family, traditions, relocation, friendships, challenges, and personal experiences shape identity. Renita reflects on repeatedly moving between India and Bahrain, adapting to new languages and schools, and overcoming challenges. She concludes that setbacks are merely chapters, and resilience, courage, kindness, humour, and adaptability help us grow. Renita is a confident, adaptable, and resilient student whose diverse experiences across cultures and schools have shaped her into an open-minded individual. She embraces change with positivity, humour, and courage. A thoughtful storyteller and keen observer, she reflects deeply on life’s experiences and draws meaningful lessons from them. Her ability to connect personal experiences with universal truths makes her a compelling speaker who inspires others to embrace change and write their own stories. title: The Story that shape us | Renita Santo | TEDxTIPS Salem Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Nel suo talk al TEDx Vibo Valentia, Tiziano Scarparo ha raccontato la medicina come una scelta di responsabilità, cura e umanità. Partendo dalla sua esperienza professionale, ha portato sul palco una riflessione sul valore dello stare accanto alle persone nei momenti più delicati, mostrando come il benessere non riguardi solo il corpo, ma anche ascolto, fiducia e consapevolezza. Il suo intervento è stato un invito a prendersi cura di sé e degli altri con attenzione, equilibrio e rispetto, trasformando ogni scelta quotidiana in un passo verso una vita più sana e autentica. Tiziano Scarparo è medico chirurgo, medico nutrizionista e divulgatore, conosciuto per il suo lavoro nel campo della dietologia, della nutrizione e del digiuno intermittente. Laureato in Medicina e Chirurgia, ha approfondito il rapporto tra alimentazione, salute e benessere, costruendo un metodo basato su educazione alimentare, personalizzazione e sostenibilità dello stile di vita. Attraverso la sua attività professi
title: Curare è esserci | TIZIANO SCARPARO | TEDxVibo Valentia

author: TEDx Talks
description: Ella uses a scientific metaphor to explore how we can avoid making negative comparisons with others, by focusing on our unique characteristics. Ella Jezdikova is a Czech-British actress, runner, and social media creator known for her warm, relatable presence online. She is recognised for creating a supportive space where she shares her personal journey and promotes self-care, shaped in part by her own past struggles with mental health. Alongside Ella’s creative work, she is academically driven and hopes to study medicine in the future, aiming to combine compassion, science, and service in her career. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Comparison is the Thief of Joy | Ella Jezdikova | TEDxPrague British Intl School Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this TEDx Talk, Divyanshu Nijhara shares his journey through uncertainty, career pivots, creative exploration, and the countless "what ifs" that shaped his life. From classrooms and film school to newsrooms, Mumbai, Delhi, branded content, and storytelling, this talk is a reminder that life's greatest opportunities often emerge when we stop waiting for the perfect plan and simply take the next step.
Through personal stories of ambition, failure, experimentation, and self-discovery, Divyanshu explores how multitasking, curiosity, and embracing the unknown helped him build a career in storytelling—and, more importantly, helped him understand what happiness truly means.
 Divyanshu Nijhara is a creative storyteller and communication professional with a Master’s in Communication, experienced across Delhi, Mumbai, and Bengaluru. His work spans podcasts, reels, short films, OTT content, documentaries, and live experiences, reflecting a strong grasp of diverse media formats. With a focus o
title: Why You Don't Need to Have Life Figured Out | Divyanshu Nijhara | TEDxSAJS Vasundhara Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
几千年前的人类就已经想象出“机器人”这样的生命了？
熊猫博士从中国《列子》中“偃师的人偶”到古印度故事中的“机器士兵”，重新讲述那些古老的故事，通过这些关于“机器生命”的神话，揭示出技术以外的人类处境：在技术飞速发展的今天，那些未被解答的关于自由、伦理与意义的问题，仍铸成了人类共有的精神焦虑。
他以一个哲人和故事讲述者的双重身份，为我们带来一次关于历史和现实的对话。 深圳大学助理教授
中国人民大学哲学博士 
广东省民族宗教学会会员 This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: 从机器生命叙事，思考古代神话的意义 | 猫 熊 | TEDxNanshan Salon

author: TEDx Talks
description:
在一个答案唾手可得的时代，我们拥有了越来越多答案，但为什么我们的迷茫却没有减少？
作为一位跨媒介艺术家，涟静通过艺术与技术的交汇，探索一个潜在的重要问题：当AI和算法大幅降低寻找答案的难度后，真正值得追寻的或许不再是答案本身，而是我们如何重新感知自己与未知的关系。
这次的演讲是一次对“不确定性”的深刻思考，也是一场关于如何在答案之外找回自己的探索。 跨媒介艺术家
一沙艺术工作室艺术总监 This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: 答案之外：如何在不确定中重新看见？ | 涟静 徐 | TEDxNanshan Salon
